tokens.name: studio-top
tokens.usage: Top of the studio ground gradient. Text on it: on-air (9.7:1).

tokens.name: studio-ink
tokens.usage: The studio ground behind every frame and inside the wall monitor. Text on it: on-air (14.9:1), on-air-muted (8.9:1), gold (8.2:1), breaking-text (6.5:1).

tokens.name: studio-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the studio ground, the ticker band, straps, the listing's project plates and the desk front. Text on it: on-air (18.4:1), gold (10.1:1).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Glossy bars: the headline bar, the ticker's clock, the rows of THE HOUR IN REVIEW, the station clock's face. Text on it: on-air (8.3:1, and 4.8:1 under the gloss), on-air-muted (4.9:1), ready-hi (6.3:1), breaking-text (3.6:1, bold 28px and up only).

tokens.name: bar-lo
tokens.usage: The lower half of a glossy bar. Text on it: on-air (10.4:1).

tokens.name: bar-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px highlight along a glossy bar's top edge. Decorative, never behind text.

tokens.name: gloss
tokens.usage: The sheen over the top half of glossy shapes. Never stronger: at 22% white text on a bar stays at 4.8:1.

tokens.name: row-hi
tokens.usage: Top of the listing's rows, the first station sketch's glossy bar. Decorative: the title sits lower.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: The listing's rows, down to the hard split at 48%. Text on it: on-air (6.5:1).

tokens.name: row-lo
tokens.usage: The listing's rows, from the hard split at 52%. Text on it: on-air (8.9:1).

tokens.name: row-base
tokens.usage: The bottom edge of the listing's rows. Text on it: on-air (7.4:1).

tokens.name: on-air
tokens.usage: Text on the studio grounds and on bars.

tokens.name: on-air-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: board meta, the project on a strap, monitor footers. On studio-ink 8.9:1, on bar 4.9:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The station's accent: trims and rules, the working state, the report on the hour. Text on it: on-gold (9.4:1). As text on studio-ink: 8.2:1.

tokens.name: gold-hi
tokens.usage: Top of gold gradients; ticker leads, the monitor's figure and a permission ask's command, on studio-ink and studio-deep.

tokens.name: gold-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom of gold gradients and the lower edge of headline bars. Decorative.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on gold (9.4:1) and gold-hi (13.3:1).

tokens.name: breaking
tokens.usage: BREAKING NEWS: the stinger and the BREAKING tab, for every story; the INPUT and ERROR pills and their monitor headers. Also the ticker's LATEST tab, which is the channel's own. Text on it: on-breaking (6.0:1).

tokens.name: breaking-hi
tokens.usage: Top of red gradients. White on it only at 28px bold and up (3.1:1).

tokens.name: breaking-deep
tokens.usage: The bottom of red gradients, the BREAKING NEWS glass panes included. Text on it: on-air (14.1:1).

tokens.name: on-breaking
tokens.usage: Text on breaking.

tokens.name: breaking-text
tokens.usage: NEEDS INPUT and BREAKING as words on studio-ink (6.5:1), and on bars at bold 28px and up (3.6:1).

tokens.name: ready
tokens.usage: Finished stories: the READY pill and the CHANGES and CLAUDE SAYS headers on the wall monitor. Text on it: on-ready (6.1:1).

tokens.name: ready-hi
tokens.usage: Top of green gradients; READY as a word on bars (6.3:1) and studio-ink.

tokens.name: ready-deep
tokens.usage: The bottom of green gradients.

tokens.name: on-ready
tokens.usage: Text on ready (6.1:1) and ready-hi (12.3:1).

tokens.name: chrome-hi
tokens.usage: The bright stops of chrome lettering, the monitor bezel and the station clock.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Chrome lettering (the bug, the stinger's words), the monitor bezel, and the station clock's bezel and hands.

tokens.name: chrome-lo
tokens.usage: The dark band across chrome lettering and the bezel's shadow side.

tokens.name: morning-top
tokens.usage: Morning, 05:00 to 11:00: sky at the top of the studio window. Decorative.

tokens.name: morning-mid
tokens.usage: Morning: sky in the middle of the window. Decorative.

tokens.name: morning-glow
tokens.usage: Morning: the horizon, warm from the low sun. Decorative.

tokens.name: morning-tower
tokens.usage: Morning: the skyline's buildings. Decorative.

tokens.name: glass-morning
tokens.usage: Morning: unlit windows, catching the sunrise. Decorative.

tokens.name: day-top
tokens.usage: Afternoon, 11:00 to 17:00: sky at the top of the window. The bug stays legible on it by its stroke and shadow. Decorative.

tokens.name: day-mid
tokens.usage: Afternoon: sky in the middle of the window. Decorative.

tokens.name: day-low
tokens.usage: Afternoon: the haze on the horizon. Decorative.

tokens.name: day-tower
tokens.usage: Afternoon: the skyline's buildings. Decorative.

tokens.name: glass-day
tokens.usage: Afternoon: windows reflecting the sky; none are lit. Decorative.

tokens.name: dusk-top
tokens.usage: Evening, 17:00 to 21:00, the station's own dusk: sky at the top of the window.

tokens.name: dusk-mid
tokens.usage: Evening: sky in the middle of the window.

tokens.name: dusk-glow
tokens.usage: Evening: the horizon glow behind the skyline. Decorative.

tokens.name: tower
tokens.usage: Evening: the skyline's buildings.

tokens.name: night-top
tokens.usage: Night, 21:00 to 05:00: sky at the top of the window, with stars. Decorative.

tokens.name: night-mid
tokens.usage: Night: sky in the middle of the window. Decorative.

tokens.name: night-low
tokens.usage: Night: the city's glow on the horizon. Decorative.

tokens.name: night-tower
tokens.usage: Night: the skyline's buildings. Decorative.

tokens.name: window-lit
tokens.usage: Lit windows: a few in the morning, none by day, a third at dusk, close to half at night. Decorative.

tokens.name: window-tv
tokens.usage: Night: windows blue with television light, one in ten. Decorative.

tokens.name: beacon
tokens.usage: Red beacons on the masts, at dusk and at night. Decorative.

tokens.name: ceramic
tokens.usage: The station mug on the desk. Decorative.

tokens.name: ceramic-shade
tokens.usage: The mug's shaded sides and its handle. Decorative.

tokens.name: coffee
tokens.usage: Inside the mug. Decorative.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The script's loose top page on the desk. Decorative.

tokens.name: paper-shade
tokens.usage: The stack under it and the pages' edges. Decorative.

tokens.name: paper-rule
tokens.usage: The script's lines of type, too small to read. Decorative.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Clawd's body, the engine's clawd_body colour, and nothing else.

tokens.name: clawd-eye
tokens.usage: Clawd's eyes and eyelids, as the engine's own Clawd art draws them. Only inside Clawd.

tokens.name: pip-black
tokens.usage: Our window behind the picture, black like macOS's picture-in-picture.

tokens.name: pip-glass
tokens.usage: The tint of our hover buttons: clear Liquid Glass, as macOS draws its picture-in-picture, the picture showing through softened and lifted, with a sheen and a rim that catches the light. Icons on it: white. Review boards mimic it; the app uses macOS's own material.

tokens.name: pip-glass-hover
tokens.usage: The glass of the hover button under the pointer, brighter. Its icon: white.

tokens.name: pip-dim
tokens.usage: The dimming over the whole picture while the hover controls show, so white glyphs on clear glass read on any frame, as Apple asks of clear glass over media.

tokens.name: pip-edge
tokens.usage: The window's hairline edge, half a point, as macOS draws round its picture-in-picture, so the black window reads on a dark desktop.

tokens.name: desktop-mock
tokens.usage: The desktop behind windows on review boards. Board furniture, never part of the feed. Captions on it: #0a0f1f (8.7:1).

tokens.name: app-ground
tokens.usage: Board furniture: the Claude desktop app's light ground in the prompt-box sketch (PromptSketch). Never part of the mod's drawing.

tokens.name: app-ground-dark
tokens.usage: Board furniture: the app's dark ground in the sketch, measured from a screenshot of the desktop app.

tokens.name: app-band
tokens.usage: Board furniture: the container the desktop draws round every mod's band, light. Inferred one step from app-ground, not measured yet.

tokens.name: app-band-dark
tokens.usage: Board furniture: the container the desktop draws round every mod's band, dark, measured: a step lighter than app-ground-dark, no border.

tokens.name: app-field
tokens.usage: Board furniture: the prompt box, light.

tokens.name: app-field-dark
tokens.usage: Board furniture: the prompt box, dark, measured.

tokens.name: app-line
tokens.usage: Board furniture: the prompt box's edge and the transcript's lines, light.

tokens.name: app-line-dark
tokens.usage: Board furniture: the prompt box's edge and the transcript's lines, dark, measured.

tokens.name: app-ink-dim
tokens.usage: Board furniture: the prompt box's placeholder and icons, light (5.1:1 on app-ground).

tokens.name: app-ink-dim-dark
tokens.usage: Board furniture: the same, dark (6.4:1 on app-field-dark).

styles.name: stinger
styles.usage: The stinger's chrome words, BREAKING NEWS, expanded (font-stretch 112%).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The lower third's headline: the event, in caps, font-stretch 110%.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one number on the wall monitor: lines changed, minutes quiet. In gold-hi.

styles.name: bug
styles.usage: The chrome bug, font-stretch 120%, with nothing added.

styles.name: board-name
styles.usage: A session's title in the listing, as it is written, one line, expanded (font-stretch 130%).

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: The coloured tab in front of a headline.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Caps labels: LATEST, monitor headers, ticker leads, and the listing's pills (INPUT, ERROR, READY, LIVE), expanded 130% on the pills.

styles.name: ots-body
styles.usage: Claude on the wall monitor: its description of a command, its question, its last words, or an error in plain words. Three lines at most.

styles.name: strap
styles.usage: The strap under a headline: which session, which project.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The second line of a row in THE HOUR IN REVIEW, slightly condensed (font-stretch 92%). Sets the legibility floor.

styles.name: ticker
styles.sample: docs-site: release notes ready for review

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The clock at the right end of the ticker, 24-hour, tabular figures.

styles.name: band-tab
styles.usage: The band's action, TUNE IN or TUNE OUT, expanded 108%. In the mod the words are outlines inside the plate's Svg, which loads no fonts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions on review boards, outside the feed. Never on the stage.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Stage units (the stage is 960 × 540). Hairline gaps inside a graphic.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between the rows of THE HOUR IN REVIEW.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between board rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of the wall monitor; gap inside the bug.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside headline bars and straps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top band offset from the top edge.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Title-safe inset from the left and right edges.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: The listing's rows.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: The listing's state pills.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Glossy bars: the rows of THE HOUR IN REVIEW.

tokens.name: radius-monitor
tokens.usage: The wall monitor's chrome bezel.

tokens.name: radius-pip
tokens.usage: Our window's corners in pt, matching macOS's picture-in-picture as measured from the supplied screenshot. Keep text out of the corners.

tokens.name: pip-shadow
tokens.usage: The window's shadow on review boards.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: The rows of THE HOUR IN REVIEW, lifted off the studio ground.

tokens.name: monitor-shadow
tokens.usage: The wall monitor, standing off the studio window.

shape.note: Local at Six's one shape rule: graphics lean forward.

tokens.name: slant
tokens.usage: The forward lean of tabs, headline bars, straps, the listing's project plates and the ticker's tab and clock. Text inside is set straight again.

frame.note: The Stage 1 decisions as numbers. Stage units (960 × 540) unless a usage note says pt.

tokens.name: stage-width
tokens.usage: Width of the stage every frame is drawn on. The picture scales uniformly with the window.

tokens.name: stage-height
tokens.usage: Height of the stage: 16:9, the window's aspect.

tokens.name: safe-inset
tokens.usage: No text closer than this to the left or right edge.

tokens.name: top-band
tokens.usage: Top of the bug.

tokens.name: lower-third-top
tokens.usage: Top of a lower third; it ends at 460px, above the ticker.

tokens.name: ticker-height
tokens.usage: The ticker band at the bottom. Nothing covers it, hover included.

tokens.name: legibility-floor
tokens.usage: Smallest text on the stage: 8.8 pt in the smallest window (300 pt wide, on a 1280 × 800 screen) and 20.9 pt at full size on a 14-inch MacBook Pro.

tokens.name: pip-min-scale
tokens.usage: The smallest you can resize the window to, as a share of its full size. Its full size is its quadrant: the window opens at it and never gets bigger.

tokens.name: pip-faded
tokens.usage: The window's opacity while Transparent window is on and the pointer is elsewhere: the whole window, so what is under it reads through. Under the pointer it is whole again. A first figure.

tokens.name: pip-margin
tokens.usage: Gap in pt between the window and every side of its quadrant, the screen's edges and its centre lines alike. The proof of concept's Layout.margin.

tokens.name: pip-control
tokens.usage: Our hover buttons' size in pt: a third bigger than macOS's 33 pt, at the user's request. They keep it in every window, 8 pt in from the top corners and 8 pt apart.

tokens.name: pip-handle-width
tokens.usage: The minimize handle's width in pt, and the tab's it leaves at the screen's edge: a glass capsule at the middle of the window's inner edge, 8 pt in, shown on hover with the other controls.

tokens.name: pip-handle-height
tokens.usage: The minimize handle's height in pt, and the tab's: twice a hover button's, centred on the window's middle. Both keep their size in a window of any size.

tokens.name: pip-tab-dark
tokens.usage: How dark the tab's glass is at the screen's edge, as pip-black at this opacity, so its white chevron reads over any app. On the window the handle is clear glass, like the other controls.

tokens.name: band-height
tokens.usage: The band above the prompt, in CSS px: the plate, the one Svg the mod draws there, is this tall, as usage-band's marks are, about a regular macOS button's height.
